description: This file defines the PaymentService interface, which specifies methods for handling payment processing, configuration, validation, and retrieval of payment methods and modules within the e-commerce system.

classes.name: PaymentService
classes.description: Interface defining payment-related operations such as processing payments and refunds, fetching available payment methods, configuration management, and validation within the system.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available payment modules for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getPaymentModulesConfigured
methods.description: Returns a map of payment module configurations for a specific store.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Processes a payment for a customer, including handling shopping cart items and the order, returning a transaction result.

methods.name: processRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a specific order, returning a transaction result.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByType
methods.description: Retrieves a specific payment module by its type (e.g., CREDITCARD, MONEYORDER).

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a payment module by its code as defined in the configuration.

methods.name: savePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Saves or updates the configuration for a specific payment module.

methods.name: validateCreditCard
methods.description: Validates credit card details such as number, type, expiry month, and date.

methods.name: getPaymentConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for a specific payment module.

methods.name: removePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes the configuration for a specified payment module.

methods.name: processCapturePayment
methods.description: Captures payment for a specific order, typically after authorization.

methods.name: getAcceptedPaymentMethods
methods.description: Returns a list of payment methods accepted by the store.

methods.name: getPaymentModule
methods.description: Retrieves a payment module by its code.
